VENDOR INVOICE - Tessellate BI   Invoice #: TB-Q1-TRUEUP   Date: 2026-03-31
Description: Q1 2026 seat true-up (14 additional seats, Jan-Mar)   Amount due: USD 2,800.00

args.text:
Q1 2026 Board Deck vs. GL — US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200)

Deck figure (DOC-0207, "Q1 2026 board deck - OpEx detail (US)"): USD 11,769.00, stated as "Prepared by FP&A from the general ledger as of 2026-04-01 09:00."

GL 6200 (US) actual Q1 activity (verified via get_account_balance and transaction listing):
- Jan-2026: 4,289.70
- Feb-2026: 4,139.80
- Mar-2026: 6,139.50
- Q1 total: 14,569.00

Difference: 14,569.00 − 11,769.00 = 2,800.00

Root cause: The variance is fully explained by one entry — JE-00304, "Tessellate BI - TB-Q1-TRUEUP - Q1 seat true-up," USD 2,800.00, dated 2026-03-31 (debit 6200 / credit 2000-AP), supported by vendor invoice DOC-0206 (Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP, dated 2026-03-31, "Q1 2026 seat true-up (14 additional seats, Jan-Mar)," USD 2,800.00). This entry's system created_at timestamp is 2026-04-02T10:14:00 — i.e., it was booked by AP the day after FP&A pulled the GL snapshot for the board deck (2026-04-01 09:00). Although dated 3/31, it simply wasn't in the ledger yet when the deck was extracted, so FP&A's report understates Q1 spend by exactly this true-up.

No other discrepancies were found in GL 6200 for Q1 (all 19 postings reconcile to properly supported vendor bills/card receipts/prepaid amortization, and the period sums tie exactly to the cumulative ending balance).

Conclusion: The correct, complete Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions figure is USD 14,569.00. The board deck's USD 11,769.00 is stale — it is missing the USD 2,800.00 Tessellate BI Q1 seat true-up (JE-00304 / DOC-0206), which posted to the ledger one business day after the deck's data was pulled. Recommend FP&A republish Appendix B with the corrected USD 14,569.00 figure; no journal entry action is needed since JE-00304 is properly supported and correctly dated within Q1. No postings were made as part of this review.

(Side observation, not in scope of this reconciliation: JE-00247 and JE-00248 are two identical USD 149.90 Zoom card charges both dated 2026-03-08 with separate but identically-worded receipts (DOC-0173/DOC-0174). This looks like it could be a duplicate charge/receipt pair rather than two distinct subscriptions — worth a quick AP/card-provider check outside this task, but it does not affect the deck-vs-GL variance analysis above since the deck total is below, not above, the GL.)
